scope: Release acceptance crawler and candidate preview only. Local source/regression evidence; no hosted acceptance or deployment claim.

changes.implementation: SPA fallback identifies the /assets namespace and root static files by location; dots inside route parameters no longer identify assets. Existing file, traversal, symlink, MIME/cache, and method checks remain in place.
changes.proof: 12 candidate-server tests: dotted strategy id and .json route parameter return index.html; missing nested/extensionless assets return 404, including Accept: text/html.

changes.implementation: A main-document navigation request closes attribution until its main-frame commit. Only requests captured from that committed main document contribute responses and finite reads. Late prior responses/aborts and requests issued before commit are excluded. Same-document redirects retain reads; retries and subsequent full document replacements clear prior read credit.
changes.proof: Synthetic event regressions plus real Chromium: old-document interval reads issue 503 while the replacement document is pending; none contribute to its data checks. An inline new-document fetch completes and is credited. Current-document aborts, incomplete bodies, and unrelated entity reads still fail.

changes.implementation: scripts/lib/management-routes.mjs loads resolveLegacyRedirect from the frontend TypeScript manifest via the existing tsx runtime dependency. The duplicated center redirect table was removed; legacy non-center/detail aliases retain their existing mapping. Query-sensitive promotion-allocation resolution also uses the manifest.
changes.proof: All manifest rules are covered by baseline/explicit samples and compared to frontend resolution; capital-live and readiness/capital-binding-live both resolve to governance-decisions. Bare-node subprocess verifies the actual TypeScript loader, separate from the Vitest loader adapter.

changes.implementation: Explicit NO_ROUTE_DATA_READS allowlist contains only /management/settings, with the reason that local preferences/static forms issue no route-specific BFF reads. Only no_completed_route_data is exempted; failures from reads that do occur still fail.
changes.proof: Every baseline pathname is checked with no data; settings is the sole exemption. Unknown settings subpaths require data, and settings with a 500 response fails.

changes.implementation: Every route JSON includes timing.startedAt, elapsedMs, navigation attempt/commit offsets and an untruncated bffRequests timeline. Each request records attempt, method, URL, attribution/exclusion reason, start/observed/response/finish/failure offsets, HTTP status and failure. Markdown prints every route/request as well. Null event times mean not observed, rather than success. No response bodies or headers are retained.
changes.proof: A failing 12-request route round-trips through JSON and the maintained Markdown formatter with all requests and start/response/failure fields; separate cases cover success, no response, and body failure after headers.

changes.implementation: No edits to transport, release budgets/timeouts, fixture 404 honesty, API failure validity, expected entity read, loading/auth rules, or existing tests.
changes.proof: Original auth/transport suites pass (52 tests); negative regressions retain current-document abort/incomplete-data failures, live-id 404 failure, and fixture 404 without honest not-found failure.
